assets.description: A friendly adult male nurse in coral scrubs with clearly visible large rolled white bandage and a care tray, waist up, dark short hair. Profession shown by the bandage task, no tiny symbols or text.

A mother in warm coral nursing scrubs with rolled bandage and her little schoolgirl in a bright mint scarf beside her, connected by an arm gently around the child. Distinct cropped family portrait, no text or symbols.

A mother in turquoise jacket seated at a very clear large school shuttle steering wheel, smiling to her little schoolgirl in a mint scarf standing beside her in the parked cab. Compact cropped illustration, no text, branding or backdrop.

A father in turquoise jacket at the same kind of very clear large school shuttle steering wheel, smiling to his little schoolgirl in a mint scarf standing beside him in the parked cab. Portrait crop like cell 3. No text, branding or backdrop.
An adult woman doctor with deep brown skin and dark curly hair, white coat and a large dark stethoscope around her neck, holding a simple small medical case. Waist-up, warm expression, no text.
One schoolboy wearing a warm cream sweater and a teal backpack, carrying a school exercise book and pencil, smiling toward the front. Clear compact waist-up portrait, no letters.

A friendly adult man crossing officer in a navy peaked cap and pine vest with a simple blank safety patch, clearly holding a bright orange crossing paddle and gesturing an open hand. Distinct from other people, no weapons or writing.
A small purple wooden moving wagon with a closed plum box and two pine green wheels, strong horizontal cut-paper silhouette, face right, clearly distinct from any orange van.
A warm apricot scrapbook sticker of two cream photo corners and one small mint leaf over a pine-green photo frame, as one connected object. No text or faces.
